name: Home Gallery
short_desc: Self-hosted open-source web gallery to view your photos and videos with tagging and AI-powered image discovery.
description: Self-hosted open-source web gallery to view your photos and videos. Features a mobile-friendly UI, tagging, and AI-powered image discovery. Builds a local index from your existing directory structure — no duplication. One-time thumbnail generation pass, then instant browsing. Uses TensorFlow.js (wasm backend) for lightweight on-device similarity search.
author: xemle
